name: Eldritch Affliction [Metamagic]
body:
Your spells can become curses.

Prerequisite(s): Extend Spell

Benefit(s): You may only apply this metamagic feat to spells with a duration of at least 1 round/caster level that do not deal damage of any kind (including hp, bleed, ability drains, and ability damage). The duration becomes permanent. The spell cannot be dispelled with dispel magic, but can be affected by spells that remove curses (such as remove curse).

The spell gains the curse descriptor. An eldritch affliction uses up a spell slot five levels higher than the spell’s actual level.
